RECORD Counter
  calls: integer
  total: integer
WHEN bump <counter>
  GIVEN counter is Counter
  THEN returns integer
  add 1 to counter.calls
  RETURN counter.calls + 2
WHEN relay <counter>
  GIVEN counter is Counter
  THEN returns integer
  RETURN bump counter
WHEN collect <counter>
  GIVEN counter is Counter
  LET total be relay counter
  set counter.total to total
GIVEN counter is Counter
  calls: 0
  total: 0
WHEN collect counter

RECORD Facts
  amount: integer
  allowed: boolean
WHEN assess <facts>
  GIVEN facts is Facts
  IF facts.amount is at least 5
    set facts.allowed to true
  ELSE
    set facts.allowed to false
GIVEN facts is Facts
  amount: 5
  allowed: false
WHEN assess facts

RECORD Item
  name: text
  value: integer
WHEN choose <items> into <selected>
  GIVEN items is list<Item>
  AND selected is Item
  find optional item in items WHERE item.name == "wanted" into selected
GIVEN items are Item
  | name | value |
  | "wanted" | 1 |
GIVEN selected is Item
  name: "previous"
  value: 7
WHEN choose items into selected
WHEN set selected.value to 99
